idea-plugin.name: AsDiff
idea-plugin.description:
AsDiff compares arbitrary text with the native IntelliJ Platform Diff Viewer, providing the same focused workflow used by Android Studio for source-control changes.

Compare text your way

  • Open Tools | Compare Text... and paste text into two resizable editor panes.
  • Select text in any editor and start a comparison from the context menu.
  • Use the selection as Left while keeping the previous Right value, or load Right directly from the text clipboard.
  • Swap or clear inputs before opening the comparison.

Native diff experience

Results use the IDE's built-in Diff Viewer, including line and inline highlighting, synchronized scrolling, and previous/next change navigation.

JSON-aware comparison

Valid JSON objects and arrays are automatically formatted with stable two-space indentation. Invalid JSON, duplicate keys, trailing content, JSON scalar values, and ordinary text are left unchanged.

Local and private

Comparison text stays inside the IDE and is never sent to a network service. Inputs are stored only in the current project's workspace settings so work can be resumed later.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.1

  • Removed the IDE build upper bound so newer Android Studio versions are not blocked by a fixed compatibility range. The minimum platform build remains 261.

1.2.0

  • Added an editor context submenu for comparing selected text.
  • Added the option to use text from the clipboard as the Right input.
  • Added strict automatic formatting for JSON objects and arrays.
  • Added persistent inputs, swap and clear controls, and cross-platform shortcuts.
